lore: A slab of obsidian around a captured star; it hums when a beacon is near.
use: Off hand, then hit a beacon or conduit 8 times with an axe (or sledgehammer) while carrying a nether star; or use the smithing table.
9 shards from the Vanilla Wither make one; with Simple Mobs also a Nether Heart, 4 diamonds and 4 crying obsidian. Only with a Nether Heart: template, crying obsidian, diamond and heart make 2.
secret: The upgraded block keeps its chosen powers, its lock and its name.

lore: A splinter of a template, still warm from the Wither's last breath.
use: Every Vanilla Wither drops one. Nine of them make a Strong Upgrade.
secret: It survives explosions, like the Nether Star beside it.

lore: Five steps closer to the sky.
use: Build a pyramid of up to 5 levels (11x11 at the bottom, 285 blocks). Level 1: Speed, Haste, Saturation; level 2: Jump Boost, Resistance, Slow Falling; level 3: Strength, Invisibility, Dolphin's Grace; level 4: Luck. Level 5 unlocks the second power.
Range 60 blocks at level 5 (with Iron), at most 340 blocks.
secret: The new powers have no level II, but Regeneration still works as the second power. The Mighty Beacon needs the Strong Beacon, six cores and two Strong Upgrades.

lore: The sea answers a larger frame with a wider reach.
use: Frame it with a 7x7x7 ring of prismarine, dark prismarine, prismarine bricks or sea lanterns (66 blocks) for up to 216 blocks of Conduit Power.
Players in the water also get Dolphin's Grace.
secret: The full large frame strikes hostile mobs in the water within 12 blocks.

lore: The sixth step is the last one.
use: Craft it: Strong Beacon in the middle, the six cores around it, a Strong Upgrade in each bottom corner. Pyramid of up to 6 levels (454 blocks). Level 4 adds Night Vision, level 5 Extra Hearts; Speed II, Jump Boost II and Resistance II are placeholders.
Level 6 unlocks the second power: Regeneration or one step higher (Speed III, four hearts).
secret: Fire Resistance and Absorption were dropped as too strong.

lore: The same slab as the Strong Upgrade, but it hums out of tune.
use: Smithing table with a beacon and a nether star, or in the world: off hand, hit a beacon 8 times with an axe or sledgehammer while carrying a nether star.
With Simple Mobs: Strong Upgrade, crying obsidian, Nether Heart and Red Nether Jewel make one.
secret: It only works on beacons, not on conduits.

lore: It does not light the way. It makes the way hard.
use: Pyramid of up to 5 levels. Level 1: Slowness, Mining Fatigue, Hunger; level 2: Weakness, Bad Luck, Oozing; level 3: Darkness, Glowing, Infested; level 4: Weaving; level 5: Nausea as the second power.
It only reaches survival players who died at least 5 minutes ago.
secret: Newcomer protection and a switched-off personal PvP of Simple Tweaks shield a player from it.

use: Craft it like the Mighty Beacon with the Evil Beacon in the middle. Pyramid of up to 6 levels; level 5 adds Wind Charged and the placeholders Hunger II and Mining Fatigue II; level 6 unlocks Nausea.
secret: The same protections as the Evil Beacon apply.
